subject: Arcadia integration: embedding Redwood runtime & MPA / next steps
messages:
From: Amy Chen <amy@arcadia.ai>
To: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek@redwood.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>
Date: Sat, 21 Nov 2026 09:12:00 -0800
Subject: Redwood runtime in Arcadia Analytics — interest & MPA

Hi Vivek / Marissa,

Following up from the partnership chat at AI Summit — Arcadia's product team is interested in bundling a lightweight, offline-capable Redwood runtime inside our Analytics Suite (desktop + cloud sync). High level asks:

- A self-contained runtime package we can ship inside the client with an option to fall back to hosted Redwood API.
- Clear guidelines on licensing, rebranding (white-label), and revenue share for sold seats.
- Security/compliance checklist for enterprise customers (SOC2 / audit logs).

We'd like to start with a small pilot (50 enterprise seats) and see how latency/cost shape up. I'll attach a short partner brief and our procurement timeline. Can your team share a mutual product agreement (MPA) template we can review?

Attaching: Arcadia_PartnerBrief_202611.pdf (see inline)

Thanks — looking forward to a quick sync next week.

Best,
Amy Chen
Head of Partnerships, Arcadia AI
amy@arcadia.ai

From: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek@redwood.com>
To: Amy Chen <amy@arcadia.ai>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik@redwood.com>
Date: Sat, 21 Nov 2026 10:02:00 -08:00
Subject: Re: Redwood runtime in Arcadia Analytics — interest & MPA

Amy — great to hear from you, and congrats again on the demo. We're excited by the use case. Quick notes before a call: 

1) Deployment models: we can support this two ways:
   - Embedded runtime (lightweight binary + quantized weights) that runs in-process in the desktop app, with an optional tokenized sync to Redwood hosted for analytics and retraining.
   - Dedicated private instance (VPC) that Arcadia can call from cloud-hosted products for the server-side features.

2) Commercial: we typically do a license + usage component for embedded scenarios (license fee + per-seat token bucket or monthly commit). For co-sell/rev-share we like to include a 12–18 month MPA that outlines responsibilities and GTM commitments.

3) Technical asks from our side to scope integration: expected monthly token volume for the pilot, target latency/seq lengths, offline size budget, and whether you need pretrained prompt sets embedded.

I've looped in Karthik (partnerships PM) to coordinate technical scoping and Marissa for commercial/operations. Would you be available for a 45-min scoping call on Monday 11/23? If so, propose 9:00–11:00 PT or 1:00–3:00 PT.

Best,
Vivek Kulkarni
VP, Partnerships — Redwood Inference
vivek@redwood.com

From: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>
To: Amy Chen <amy@arcadia.ai>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek@redwood.com>
Cc: Karthik Iyer <karthik@redwood.com>, Sergio Alvarez <sergio@redwood.com>
Date: Sat, 21 Nov 2026 11:25:00 -08:00
Subject: Re: Redwood runtime in Arcadia Analytics — interest & MPA

Amy — thanks for the brief, this looks promising. A couple of commercial guardrails to get us started: 

- For a pilot (50 seats) we typically offer a trial license + short-term commit; pricing tiers change once you cross 500 seats.
- Rev-share: standard starting point is 15% of net revenue attributable to the embedded feature, with a joint GTM commitment (co-marketing credits, case study).
- IP/derivative rights: Redwood will grant a runtime redistributable license; model weights remain Redwood-owned unless an enterprise purchase is negotiated.

I'll attach an initial MPA draft (Arcadia_MPA_v1.pdf) that lays out scope, payment terms, support SLAs, and data handling. Please review and flag any non-starters.

Next steps I propose:
- Monday scoping call (Vivek/Karthik/Arcadia Eng + product)
- Post-call: MPA redline within 3 business days
- Technical appendix (Soojin to prepare)

Attaching: Arcadia_MPA_v1.pdf

--
Marissa Cole
Head of Revenue Partnerships, Redwood Inference
marissa@redwood.com

From: Daniel Park <daniel.park@arcadia.ai>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik@redwood.com>
Cc: Amy Chen <amy@arcadia.ai>, Luis Ramos <l.ramos@arcadia.ai>
Date: Sat, 21 Nov 2026 13:05:00 -08:00
Subject: Re: Redwood runtime in Arcadia Analytics — interest & MPA

Thanks Marissa / Vivek — Arcadia is aligned in principle on the commercial approach. A few clarifying points from engineering/procurement: 

- Pilot sizing: 50 enterprise seats, expected ~1.5M tokens/month aggregated across customers during pilot.
- Offline bundle: target compressed runtime <120MB; we need to confirm quantization options and supported platforms (macOS x64/arm + Windows x64).
- Security: procurement will need SOC2 type II evidence and a sample data retention policy.

We're keen to review the MPA and run the scoping call. Are you able to add a technical appendix (deployment checklist) and a preliminary integration diagram? That would help our infra team scope the pilot.

Thanks,
Daniel Park
Director, Product Integrations — Arcadia AI
+1 (415) 555-0127

From: Karthik Iyer <karthik@redwood.com>
To: Daniel Park <daniel.park@arcadia.ai>, Amy Chen <amy@arcadia.ai>
Cc: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>, Soojin Lee <soojin@redwood.com>, Sergio Alvarez <sergio@redwood.com>
Date: Sat, 21 Nov 2026 15:48:00 -08:00
Subject: Re: Redwood runtime in Arcadia Analytics — integration checklist & next steps

Daniel / Amy — great, appreciate the clarity. Attached are the two things you requested: a draft integration checklist (arcadia_integration_checklist.xlsx) and a simple integration diagram (integration_diagram.png). High-level technical notes: 

- We can deliver a quantized 4-bit runtime that meets your 120MB target on macOS arm/x64 and Windows x64. We will provide platform-specific build artifacts and a small C++ shim for embedding.
- For telemetry: we support an opt-in sync to Redwood hosted metrics (anonymized) for usage reporting; customers can disable sync entirely and run fully offline.
- Security artifacts: linking SOC2 summary + contact for security questionnaire in the Drive folder below.

Next steps / milestones (proposed):
1) Sign MPA (DocuSign link below) to enable engineering access and NDA scope — target EOD Tues 11/24.
2) Deliver pilot build (alpha) to Arcadia dev by 12/10.
3) Pilot validation period (4 weeks) and joint performance report.

DocuSign (MPA): https://docusign.net/1pzXxGQ/Arcadia-MPA
Drive (security + tech appendix): https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/arcadia-integration-2026

Attachments: arcadia_integration_checklist.xlsx, integration_diagram.png, docusign_mpa_link.txt
